data.name: Argument_Inputs
data.value: Files or folders (folders: the files matching --pattern).

data.name: Argument_Operation
data.value: The operation id, e.g. optimize.compress (see list-ops).

data.name: Argument_Workflow
data.value: A .pdfflow file, or a built-in workflow: digitize, publish, print.

data.name: Command_Convert
data.value: Convert: to pictures, text, PDF/A, grey, web; pictures or Office documents to PDF.

data.name: Command_Decrypt
data.value: Remove the protection (needs the owner password in --password).

data.name: Command_Info
data.value: What a PDF is (pages, sizes, protection, description, fonts…).

data.name: Command_ListOps
data.value: List every operation and its parameters.

data.name: Command_Merge
data.value: Merge files into one PDF (-o name.pdf).

data.name: Command_Redact
data.value: Redact by pattern (ID numbers, phones, e-mails, bank accounts, dates, an expression).

data.name: Command_Run
data.value: Run any operation, with -p name=value or --params JSON.

data.name: Command_Split
data.value: Split PDFs by ranges, page count, bookmarks, size or blank pages.

data.name: Command_Stamp
data.value: Add page numbers, a header/footer or Bates numbers.

data.name: Error_Certificate
data.value: The .pfx certificate cannot be read (wrong password or not a .pfx file).

data.name: Error_CertificateNoKey
data.value: The certificate has no private key to sign with.

data.name: Error_DecryptPassword
data.value: The owner password is needed: --password or the PDFPRO_PASSWORD variable.

data.name: Error_Exists
data.value: The file exists: {0} (use --overwrite to replace it).

data.name: Error_Log
data.value: The log file cannot be written.

data.name: Error_NoFiles
data.value: There is no file to process.

data.name: Error_OwnerPassword
data.value: An owner password is needed: --owner-password or the PDFPRO_OWNER_PASSWORD variable.

data.name: Error_ParamsJson
data.value: --params must be a JSON object or a file holding one.

data.name: Error_RedactNothing
data.value: Choose at least one pattern (--pattern) or --regex.

data.name: Error_RedactPattern
data.value: "{0}" is not a pattern (cccd, phone, email, account, date).

data.name: Error_SecretsFile
data.value: The secrets file must be a JSON object of objects.

data.name: Failure_Input
data.value: the file does not exist or cannot be read

data.name: Failure_Output
data.value: the result cannot be written (output folder?)

data.name: Failure_Parameters
data.value: the parameters do not fit the file: {0}

data.name: Failure_Password
data.value: the file is protected: its owner password is needed (--password)

data.name: Failure_Secrets
data.value: a password or certificate for this step is missing

data.name: Failure_Unreadable
data.value: the file is damaged or not a readable PDF

data.name: Issue_NeedsSeveralFiles
data.value: the operation takes several files at once, it cannot be a step

data.name: Issue_NoSteps
data.value: the workflow has no enabled step

data.name: Issue_NotForFiles
data.value: the operation only works in an open document

data.name: Issue_OnlyFirst
data.value: this operation can only be the first step

data.name: Issue_OnlyLast
data.value: this operation does not write one PDF, so it can only be the last step

data.name: Issue_ProtectionNotLast
data.value: protecting with a password must be the last step

data.name: Issue_ReplaceNeedsOnePdf
data.value: replacing the input needs a workflow that writes one PDF

data.name: Issue_TooManySteps
data.value: the workflow has too many steps

data.name: Option_AllPages
data.value: Recognise every page, even those with text.

data.name: Option_Allow
data.value: Permissions, comma-separated: print, printHighQuality, modify, copy, annotate, fillForms, assemble.

data.name: Option_Bates
data.value: Bates numbers with this prefix, running on across the files.

data.name: Option_InPlace
data.value: Replace each input with its result.

data.name: Option_KeepText
data.value: Keep the rest of the page's text and drawings (advanced; default: pages as pictures).

data.name: Option_Log
data.value: Write the batch log to a CSV file.

data.name: Option_NoBookmarks
data.value: Keep no bookmarks and add none per file.

data.name: Option_Out
data.value: The output folder (default: the current folder; for merge: a .pdf file name).

data.name: Option_Overwrite
data.value: Replace results of the same name (never an input).

data.name: Option_OwnerPassword
data.value: The owner password (or the PDFPRO_OWNER_PASSWORD variable).

data.name: Option_PageNumbers
data.value: Page numbers by a pattern, e.g. "Page {page}/{pages}".

data.name: Option_Parallel
data.value: Files run at once (0 = half the processors).

data.name: Option_Params
data.value: Parameters as JSON (text or a file).

data.name: Option_Password
data.value: The owner password of protected inputs (or the PDFPRO_PASSWORD variable).

data.name: Option_Pattern
data.value: File name patterns in folders (default *.pdf; several separated by ;).

data.name: Option_Preset
data.value: Preset: screen, ebook, print, archive, custom.

data.name: Option_RedactPatterns
data.value: Patterns, comma-separated: cccd, phone, email, account, date.

data.name: Option_Redo
data.value: Recognise again pages with an old hidden text layer.

data.name: Option_Secrets
data.value: A JSON file of passwords for the steps that need them (by operation id or step number).

data.name: Option_SplitBookmarks
data.value: By bookmarks down to this level.

data.name: Option_To
data.value: Target: pdf, png, jpeg, tiff, text, markdown, pdfa, pdfa1b, grayscale, web.

data.name: Option_Ltv
data.value: Add long-term validation data (certificates, revocation lists downloaded).

data.name: Option_UserPassword
data.value: The open password (or PDFPRO_USER_PASSWORD); none = anyone opens it.

data.name: Option_Visible
data.value: A visible signature in the bottom right corner of the first or last page (default: invisible).

data.name: RootDescription
data.value: PDF_Pro: PDF documents from the command line.

data.name: Warning_BreaksSignature
data.value: Warning: step {0} ({1}) comes after signing and breaks the signature.
